title: Tokens After Goodbye
summary: Trace access-token replay across logout and password change, then verify one-use refresh rotation.
description: ApertureOps needs a deterministic review of session invalidation and refresh-token reuse handling.

objectives.title: Build the replay timeline
objectives.label: Compare vulnerable and hardened state transitions

objectives.title: Prove revocation and rotation
objectives.label: Validate logout, password-change, and refresh-family controls

learningOutcomes: Distinguish token expiry from server-side revocation
Compare replay before and after logout and password change
Verify one-use refresh rotation and family revocation on reuse
